question: 79 plates were purchased at ₹79 and 13 plates were broken during transportation. The trader sells the remaining plates at ₹5.90 each. Then, find the trader's profit.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Selling Price = Remaining plates × Selling price per plate

Total Selling Price = (79 − 13) × 5.90 = 66 × 5.90 = ₹389.40

Total Cost Price = ₹79

Profit = Total SP − Total CP = 389.40 − 79 = ₹310.40

**∴ The correct answer is ₹310.40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total cost price of 79 plates = ₹79

Number of broken plates = 13

Selling price per plate = ₹5.90

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Total Selling Price − Total Cost Price
